name: Pierre-Ange Carlotti
bio: Born in Corsica in 1989, lives and works in Paris, France. He began taking pictures at a young age and he studied photography at the École Nationale Supérieure des Beaux-Arts in Paris, where he graduated with honors.

credits.title: Forty Love
credits.overview: Sacha Gallo, a tennis prodigy, has been training with his father to win a major trophy in Paris. But the arrival of a charismatic new rival challenges everything Sacha thought he understood about competition, ambition, and himself.

credits.title: Islands
credits.overview: A sexual reverie unfolds over the course of one ethereal night. Characters wander through an erotic maze of love and lust, blurring the lines between wet dream and lucid nightmare as a macabre, erotic stage performance sends a ripple of lustful desires through its audience and performers.
